lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity maxima are distributed in a semi-regular grid; a prominent cluster of four large, high-luminance circular blobs forms a trapezoid in the upper-mid region of the visible flank, with denser, smaller clusters positioned anteriorly near the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical linear gradients of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical axes of the primary blobs, forming a discernible lattice structure particularly in the posterior half of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two primary horizontal features are visible; the uppermost ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with high-luminance highlights on the dorsal edge and deep blue-gray shadows on the ventral edge, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Several high-reflectance, elongated pixel clusters (likely commensal fish) are visible trailing the trailing edge and ventral surface of the primary pectoral fin.
